launches.tagline: Enabling analog circuit designers to tokenmaxx
launches.body:
Hello World!\
We are [Sayan Mitra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sayanmitra9/), [Atman Kar](https://www.linkedin.com/in/atman-kar/) and [Rithik Jain](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rithik--jain/), the team behind Atrisa!

We are launching **Atrisa**, an AI agent for analog circuit design - enabling analog circuit designers to tokenmaxx!

Atrisa is the AI-native way to build analog circuits.

Right now, frontier LLMs struggle making analog circuits. Designing industry grade analog circuits relies on “tribal knowledge” and internal company data - which LLMs have never seen.

Atrisa has internalized the intuition of an analog engineer - enabling you to design, understand, and debug analog circuits with natural language!\
[https://youtu.be/YupbVdchblk](https://youtu.be/YupbVdchblk?si=HJebBGL3UqALNAXh)

\
Atrisa hierarchically reasons about your circuit, finds the right topologies to match your specifications, and does deep-dive debugging and experimentation.

It takes into context everything an analog engineer would need: Reusability across older designs, possible interference, parasitics, and physical layout context. It can talk to other instances, so you don't get blocked by another engineer’s availability.

Along with providing a modern chat-based interface, Atrisa fits seamlessly into your existing workflows. You can bring your existing toolkit, PDKs, design docs, and Atrisa will understand and adopt.
